text:
Matt: noticed steady GPU mem creep on ded-rt-3 when INT8 quantization is enabled and workloads hit long contexts (~12k tokens). heap/slabmap shows gradual growth over ~20m: puzzled :thinking:
Anya: can you share repro details + model/config?
Matt: replaying longchat-2 with kernel selection=auto, coalesce-small-pages=false. mem climbs after ~8k tokens. CPU idles; GPU resident increases.
Leah: paste the profiler/kv stats dump? trimmed is fine.
Matt: here you go:
```
KV cache: pages=12456 slots=10432 fragbytes=67.2MB resident=2.14GB
pages_warm=8123 pages_cold=4333 coalesce_ops=0
evictions=24 paged_out=412 pending_writes=0
quant_mode=INT8 kernel=triton/auto seq_len=12288
GC rounds=3 avg_free_per_round=4.2MB
per-token latency p50=12.4ms p95=28.9ms
```
Chen: coalesce_ops=0 but warm>cold. suggests we never merged small fragments after int8 changed packing. plausible cause for added slabs -> resident growth.
Anya: int8 halves element width, so small tail fragments may not meet the current coalesce threshold tuned for FP16/BF16. fragmentation increases.
Matt: also seeing read amplification: more page table hits in hot path. attaching kernel selection log. cc runtime-bot for verbatim logs.
runtime-bot: kernel_decision: selected=triton_fused_attention_int8
runtime-bot: fallback_candidate=cuBLAS_attention_fp16
runtime-bot: reason=quant_mode_priority, warmup_hist=low
Leah: theory: coalesce threshold tuned to element-size A; effective_slot_utilization = used_bytes / allocated_bytes. INT8 reduces used_bytes per slot->coalesce score falls below the threshold. result: smaller fragments remain, extra allocations.
Chen: quick experiments to run:
- enable coalesce-small-pages when int8 active
- drop coalesce threshold from 0.6 -> 0.35
- opportunistic slot-reuse on cold->warm promotion
Anya: capture accuracy impact. earlier naive int8+coalesce runs gave ~0.8% logprob drop on some evals. need A/B.
Matt: spun a canary on ded-rt-3 with coalesce-small-pages=true and lowered threshold. resident stabilized ~1.9GB vs 2.14GB baseline for same token count.
Leah: latency impact? any regressions?
Matt: p50 unchanged, p95 improved ~1.2ms (fewer page misses). but micro eval shows minor token-level mismatches for a subset.
Chen: could be nondeterminism from different physical page layouts after coalescing. int8 kernels are already numerically tight; ordering / fetch timing under contention can change rounding.
Anya: action items:
- [Matt] run 1k eval samples A/B coalesce on vs off, record logprob, token mismatch rate
- [Leah] add telemetry counters: coalesce_ops, fragbytes_per_shard, kernel_binding_events
- [Chen] make coalesce threshold autotuner quant-aware (compute effective_slot_size = base_slot_size / (quant_bits/8))
- [runtime-bot] annotate kernel selection logs with fragbytes and coalesce_score
Matt: microtrace from an eviction incident (2-request batch) shows double-load race for same slot:
```
TRACE: req1 fetch(slot=4231) miss -> load page 731
TRACE: req2 fetch(slot=4231) miss -> load page 731 (race)
TRACE: eviction candidate slot=842 freed
```
Anya: we should singleflight page loads to avoid duplicate pulls and spikes.
Leah: small code patch suggestion: singleflight per page key + bump slot refcount on load path before releasing lock.
Chen: longer-term: make coalesce decision based on observed seq_len distribution and quant packing. cheap estimator: effective_slot_bytes = base_slot_bytes * (8 / quant_bits). then run tuner with moving average.
Matt: will run the A/B and post numbers. if int8+coalesce keeps mem stable and quality delta <0.2% we'll flip default behind a feature flag.
ops-bot: deploy request created: canary/ded-rt-3/coalesce-int8-2026-03-18
Matt: ping me for logs/replay script.
Anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
